summary.intent: User asked to start up the full local CipherBox dev stack (Docker services, API, web dev server).
summary.outcome: Brought the stack fully up: started the missing web dev server on :5173, diagnosed and fixed a healthcheck bug in the mock-ipns-routing container definition, confirmed it now reports healthy, and committed the docker-compose.yml fix.

repo: mock-ipns-routing container was chronically 'unhealthy' due to its Docker healthcheck resolving 'localhost' to IPv6 inside the container, which failed to connect; fix required updating the healthcheck in docker/docker-compose.yml.
The container's healthcheck was also probing the wrong port — actual API port had to be cross-checked against main.ts before correcting the healthcheck command.

code.finding: mock-ipns-routing service healthcheck needed updating to use the correct localhost form (avoid IPv6 resolution) and correct port matching the app's actual listen port from main.ts.

workflow: When a compose-defined container reports unhealthy, check the healthcheck command directly (docker inspect) and probe the port from inside the container before assuming an app-level bug.

friction: A Bash call to read/grep .env alongside the compose healthcheck lines was denied, requiring the check to be split into separate commands.

Diagnosing the unhealthy container took many sequential steps (inspect healthcheck, probe inside container, find compose file, cross-reference app port in main.ts) before the root cause (IPv6 localhost + wrong port) was confirmed.
